title: Payment recording & invoice status
description: Record a payment against an invoice (amount, mode, date, note). Invoice status auto-updates UNPAID -> PARTIAL -> PAID.
acceptanceCriteria: Partial payment correctly reduces outstanding balance and sets status PARTIAL
Multiple partial payments against one invoice are all retained

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting - there's no invoice list screen anywhere yet (Payments tab is still a placeholder), so building that too as the natural home for this ticket's payment-recording entry point, matching the wireframe. Reminder buttons (LODGY-18/19) intentionally left off the list rows for now, added when those tickets land.

Built PaymentRepository (create, getTotalPaid summing all payments for an invoice), extended InvoiceRepository (getAll, getById, updateStatus) and TenancyAgreementRepository (getById). InvoiceListScreen now backs the Payments tab: reactive Flow<List<Invoice>> enriched per-invoice with tenant name + total paid (N+1 lookups, acceptable at single-hostel scale), All/Unpaid/Partial/Paid filter chips, Record button per unpaid/partial row. RecordPaymentScreen pre-fills the amount field with the remaining balance, mode as filter chips, date picker, optional note; save() writes the payment then recomputes totalPaid and sets status via the exact AC-specified thresholds (>=amountDue -> PAID, >0 -> PARTIAL, else UNPAID stays). Because invoiceRepository.getAll() is a live Flow and the invoice row itself gets updated with the new status, the list screen picks up the change automatically on popping back - no manual refresh. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. On-device pass (multiple partial payments accumulating correctly, in particular) still queued.
